entries.subject: Herschel effective diameter
entries.finding: Herschel’s effective primary diameter sets the size. Rotational photometry is insufficient to select unique three-dimensional axes.

entries.subject: JWST spectroscopy as surface data
entries.finding: [JWST spectroscopy](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2024.116017) constrains integrated composition but supplies no registered terrain or albedo map.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered terrain or albedo map of Sedna is released.
